camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeBlockingPolicies --region cn-hangzhou --BlockingStatus 1 --PageSize 10 --BlockingType ip --EndTime 1788393600000 --NextToken '""' --MaxResults 10 --StartTime 1788307200000 --SortOrder desc --Page 1 --BlockingDirection in --SortField blocking_time --BlockingEntity '203.0.113.10' --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the retained blocking policy, effective status, expiration time, and task statistics for the current account by using paging
description_zh: 分页查询当前账号保留的封禁策略及生效状态、过期时间和任务统计
kebab_example: aliyun ndr describe-blocking-policies --page 1 --page-size 10 --blocking-type ip --blocking-entity 203.0.113.10 --blocking-direction in --blocking-status 1 --start-time 1788307200000 --end-time 1788393600000 --sort-field blocking_time --sort-order desc --max-results 10 --next-token '""' --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBlockingPolicies

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始，省略时为 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. If the value is less than or equal to 0, it is treated as 10. If the value is greater than 100, it is treated as 100. Specify a value from 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10；小于等于 0 时按 10，大于 100 时按 100。建议传入 1～100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The blocking type filter. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address, and a value of domain indicates a domain name. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by type
parameters.help_zh: 封禁类型筛选。ip 表示 IPv4，domain 表示域名；省略时不按类型筛选
parameters.name: blocking_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword for the blocking entity. A fuzzy match is performed on the IPv4 address or domain name. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by entity
parameters.help_zh: 封禁实体关键词，对 IPv4 或域名做包含匹配；省略时不按实体筛选
parameters.name: blocking_entity

parameters.help_en: The direction filter. An exact match is performed based on in, out, or bidirectional. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by direction. A value of in does not match bidirectional
parameters.help_zh: 方向筛选，按 in、out 或 bidirectional 精确匹配；省略时不按方向筛选。in 不会同时匹配 bidirectional
parameters.name: blocking_direction

parameters.help_en: The blocking status of the policy. A value of 0 indicates that the policy is not effective, and a value of 1 indicates that the policy is effective. To check whether a task is still running, query the task status separately. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by this field
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态。 省略时不按该字段筛选
parameters.name: blocking_status

parameters.help_en: The lower bound of the query range for the policy blocking time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is inclusive. If this parameter is not specified, no lower bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询下界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制下界
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The upper bound of the query range for the policy blocking time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. The boundary is inclusive. If this parameter is not specified, no upper bound is applied
parameters.help_zh: 策略封禁时间的查询上界，Unix 毫秒时间戳，包含边界；省略时不限制上界
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The sort field. A value of blocking_time sorts the results by the policy blocking time, which is the default value. A value of blocking_count sorts the results by the total number of successful task records for the same type and entity. This does not represent the number of hits
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。blocking_time 按策略封禁时点排序（默认），blocking_count 按同类型、同实体的成功任务记录总数排序；并非命中数
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en: The sort order. A value of asc indicates ascending order, and a value of desc indicates descending order. Default value: desc
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。asc 表示升序，desc 表示降序；默认降序
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This parameter is not used to control the number of returned entries. Use PageSize to specify the number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，当前不用于控制返回数量；请使用 PageSize 设置每页条数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter for compatibility. This operation does not support cursor-based pagination. Omit this parameter and use Page and PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
parameters.help_zh: 兼容保留参数，本接口不支持游标分页；请省略此参数，使用 Page 和 PageSize。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The processing result of the request

Data.description_en: The business result returned by the operation
Data.description_zh: 本次操作返回的业务结果

List.description_en: The list of blocking policy information on the current page. The list may be empty if no matches are found
List.description_zh: 本页封禁策略信息列表，无匹配时可能为空

items.description_en: The information about a blocking policy

BlockingCount.description_en: The number of retained and successfully executed task records for the same blocking type and entity. This includes tasks such as blocking, unblocking, modifying, and deleting configurations. It does not represent the number of rule hits. This statistic is not limited by the start and end time filters of the current query
BlockingCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前保留的执行成功任务记录数，包含封禁、解封、修改及删除配置等任务，不是规则命中次数；此统计不受本次起止时点筛选限制
BlockingCount.title_en: 该实体的封禁任务总次数
BlockingCount.title_zh: 该实体的封禁任务总次数

BlockingDirection.description_en: The blocking direction. A value of in indicates the inbound direction, a value of out indicates the outbound direction, and a value of bidirectional indicates both directions. This field may be empty when the policy is not effective
BlockingDirection.description_zh: 封禁方向。in 表示入方向，out 表示出方向，bidirectional 表示双向。 策略未生效时可能为空

BlockingEntity.description_en: The IPv4 address or domain name of the blocked object
BlockingEntity.description_zh: 封禁对象的 IPv4 地址或域名
BlockingEntity.title_en: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）
BlockingEntity.title_zh: 被封禁的实体（IP 或域名）

BlockingExpireTime.description_en: The blocking expiration time. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that the blocking never expires
BlockingExpireTime.description_zh: 封禁过期时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。0 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_en: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期
BlockingExpireTime.title_zh: 封禁过期时间戳（毫秒），null 表示永不过期

BlockingReason.description_en: The blocking reason. This field may be empty
BlockingReason.title_en: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空
BlockingReason.title_zh: 封禁原因摘要，可能为空

BlockingStatus.description_en: The blocking status of the policy. A value of 0 indicates that the policy is not effective, and a value of 1 indicates that the policy is effective. To check whether a task is still running, query the task status separately
BlockingStatus.description_zh: 策略封禁状态。0 表示未生效，1 表示已生效；任务是否仍在执行需另查任务状态
BlockingStatus.title_en: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效
BlockingStatus.title_zh: 封禁状态：0-未生效 / 1-已生效

BlockingTime.description_en: The most recent blocking time of the policy record. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds. When sorting by blocking_count, the current value is 0, which is not a valid time. To obtain a valid value, sort and query by blocking_time
BlockingTime.description_zh: 策略记录的最近封禁时间，Unix 毫秒时间戳。按 blocking_count 排序时当前为 0，不是有效时点；需要有效值时请按 blocking_time 排序查询

BlockingType.description_en: The object type. A value of ip indicates an IPv4 address, and a value of domain indicates a domain name
BlockingType.description_zh: 封禁对象类型。ip 表示 IPv4 地址，domain 表示域名

PendingTaskCount.description_en: The number of task records that are pending or being executed for the same blocking type and entity. This includes blocking and unblocking tasks. It does not represent the number of policies
PendingTaskCount.description_zh: 同一封禁类型和实体当前待执行或执行中的任务记录数，包含封禁和解封任务，不是策略数量
PendingTaskCount.title_en: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数
PendingTaskCount.title_zh: 该实体待生效的封禁任务个数

Page.description_en: The page number used for the current query. Pages start from 1
Page.description_zh: 本次查询采用的页码，从 1 开始

PageSize.description_en: The page size used for the current query. This is not equal to the actual number of entries returned on the current page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次采用的分页大小，不等于本页实际返回条数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of policies that meet the filter conditions. This is not the number of entries returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合筛选条件的策略总数，不是本页返回条数

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. The value is an empty string when the request is successful. The example InvalidParam indicates that the request parameter is invalid and does not represent the error code of a successful response
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；成功时为空字符串。示例 InvalidParam 表示请求参数无效，不代表成功响应的错误码

MaxResults.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This field does not provide a valid page size. Refer to Data.PageSize. The example only illustrates the field format
MaxResults.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，当前不提供有效分页大小；请以 Data.PageSize 为准。示例仅说明字段格式

Message.description_en: The result description of the request. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 本次请求的结果说明；成功时为 success，失败时返回错误说明

NextToken.description_en: A reserved field for compatibility. This operation does not provide a cursor for the next page. Paginate based on Data.TotalCount, Data.Page, and Data.PageSize. The example uses double quotes in JSON to represent an empty string, which is not a valid cursor
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容保留字段，本接口不提供下一页游标；请依据 Data.TotalCount、Data.Page 和 Data.PageSize 翻页。示例以 JSON 的双引号表示空字符串，不是可用游标

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the ID to troubleshoot and locate the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于排查和定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the API call was successful. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully, and a value of false indicates that the request failed. For asynchronous operations, a success response does not mean that the task has been completed
Success.description_zh: 本次接口调用是否成功。true 表示请求处理成功，false 表示失败；异步接口的成功不表示任务已经执行完成
